A dramatic rescue unfolds as an excavator’s bucket, partially submerged in turbulent water, is used to lift and transport several people to safety. The bucket, maneuvered by an operator, acts as a makeshift boat, carrying the individuals across the choppy waters near a rocky shoreline where onlookers watch. The scene captures the precariousness of the rescue, with one person clinging to the bucket’s edge, highlighting the urgency and danger of the situation.

A group of people, including a man in a black tracksuit, are seen climbing into the bucket of a large yellow excavator on a snowy, rocky shoreline. As the excavator begins to move, the crowd watches from the shore, some recording the event on their phones, as the machine slowly transports the individuals away from the water’s edge.

A crowd gathers on a muddy riverbank as a yellow excavator lowers its bucket into the water, rescuing a person who was submerged. The excavator carefully lifts the individual, who is wrapped in a dark blanket, out of the water and onto the bank, where onlookers watch anxiously.

A group of people, including rescuers in dark uniforms, are actively involved in a dramatic ice rescue operation. A yellow Caterpillar excavator is positioned on the ice near the water's edge, its bucket used to lift a person from the icy water. The crowd watches intently as the excavator carefully extracts the individual, highlighting the coordinated effort to save a life in a hazardous, cold environment.
A person is rescued from icy water by being lifted out of the water in the bucket of a large yellow excavator, which is then maneuvered to a safe, rocky shoreline where rescuers assist them out.

A yellow Komatsu excavator operates on a partially frozen body of water, using its bucket to carefully lift and extract a large, dark, submerged object—likely a whale or large marine animal—from the icy surface. A crowd of onlookers gathers on the ice and nearby land, watching the rescue or recovery operation unfold under an overcast sky.
